Thanks Jordan — Wed 06/02 09:30 PT is good on our side for the PDM intro. I'll send a calendar invite.

To answer your question on prerequisites: the typical ACE checklist includes an AWS marketplace listing (Private offers or listing), customer references, basic security questionnaire completion, and a mutual action plan outlining pilot success criteria. No strict minimum usage commitment is required for ACE registration, though PDMs sometimes want a sizing estimate for expected pilot TPS to confirm feasibility.

For the intake ahead of Wed's call, could you: 
- Complete the ACE intake checklist (I attached) and return by EOD Tue 06/01 if possible
- Share a short bullet list of expected monthly inference volume and key data residency constraints

I'll also attach the intake checklist again and a short roadmap for the pilot in the calendar invite.

Invite will include: Naomi, Jordan, Alicia (PDM), Marissa (partnerships), Ben (solutions), and Aditya (sales engineering).

— Naomi
